title: Restore original Leaf design and add desktop layout
purpose: Return Leaf to its established warm mobile design and plant passport while adding a small colored-pencil garden illustration and a wider desktop presentation without changing stored records or export contracts.
changes: Reverted the responsive garden dashboard redesign to restore the previous Leaf navigation, pages, typography, colors, cards, and plant passport.
Added a transparent colored-pencil illustration of grass, flowers, and pots to the original home screen.
Added a desktop-only layout that moves navigation to the top and displays home plant cards in two columns while preserving the mobile layout.

tests.name: npm.cmd run build
tests.details: Vite build completed; the existing large-chunk warning remains.

tests.name: Responsive visual check
tests.details: Verified the home screen at 390x844 and 1200x900, and opened the restored plant passport in the local app.

next_actions: Deploy the verified build when publication is requested.
